analysis_methods: Validate source hashes, normalized records, record counts, export metadata, and every exported payload hash
Compare independently generated export files byte for byte
comparability_requirements: Repeat runs use byte-identical declared inputs and the same package version
exclusion_criteria: Any run with modified fixture bytes, configuration, or contract version
protocol.hypothesis: Versioned validation, normalization, provenance, and export mechanics can operate deterministically on fabricated input.

independent_variable.name: software-run
independent_variable.operational_definition: A local invocation of the versioned Apex Labs mechanics against the immutable synthetic fixture.

minimum_sample_requirements.rationale: This is a deterministic software demonstration requirement, not a scientific sample-size claim.
requirements: Use exactly one immutable synthetic fixture and repeat generation independently at least twice

notes: This protocol exists only to keep the mechanics finding separate from the first real racing campaign.
Its finding must remain synthetic_demo and do_not_implement.
protocol.null_hypothesis: The software path cannot reproduce the same normalized and export artifacts from the same fabricated input.

criteria: All structural validators and integrity checks pass
falsification_criteria: Any input-bound hash mismatch is accepted
Repeated identical inputs produce different normalized or export bytes

primary_dependent_metric.definition: Count of validated normalized telemetry-sample records.

protocol.randomization_counterbalancing: Not applicable to a deterministic software fixture; repeated outputs are compared byte for byte.
protocol.research_question: Can the Milestone 0 software path process a tiny synthetic dataset while refusing to treat it as scientific evidence?
safety_constraints: Use only fabricated data with no real driver, customer, simulator, or production source
Never infer racing performance from the fixture

randomization.method: Deterministic synthetic mechanics fixture; no participant assignment
